reviews.subject: CPSC 120 Intro to Programming
reviews.review: SAMPLE: Clear lectures and very approachable in office hours. Weekly labs build real skill and grading is transparent.

reviews.subject: CPSC 131 Data Structures
reviews.review: SAMPLE: Material is tough and projects are time-consuming, but the recursion and linked list walkthroughs are excellent.

reviews.subject: CPSC 223 Advanced Programming
reviews.review: SAMPLE: Fast-paced but fair. Exams mirror the homework, and she gives detailed code feedback.

reviews.subject: MATH 150A Calculus I
reviews.review: SAMPLE: Patient teacher who does plenty of worked examples. Quizzes every week keep you on track.

reviews.subject: MATH 338 Statistics
reviews.review: SAMPLE: Lectures are dry and the exams are much harder than the practice problems.

reviews.subject: BIOL 101 General Biology
reviews.review: SAMPLE: Funny, organized, and posts slides early. Extra credit opportunities are generous.

reviews.subject: CHEM 120A General Chemistry
reviews.review: SAMPLE: Knows the subject deeply, but pacing is quick. Go to the tutoring sessions.

reviews.subject: ENGL 101 Composition
reviews.review: SAMPLE: Gives thoughtful essay feedback and lets you revise. Great for first-year students.

reviews.subject: HIST 110 US History
reviews.review: SAMPLE: Engaging storyteller. Two papers and a midterm, with clear rubrics.

reviews.subject: PSYC 101 Intro to Psychology
reviews.review: SAMPLE: Interactive class with real-world examples. Reading load is light and exams are multiple choice.

reviews.subject: MGMT 339 Organizational Behavior
reviews.review: SAMPLE: Group project heavy. Lectures are fine but attendance is required.

reviews.subject: FIN 320 Business Finance
reviews.review: SAMPLE: Hard subject made manageable with Excel walkthroughs. Expect weekly problem sets.

reviews.subject: ECON 201 Microeconomics
reviews.review: SAMPLE: Explains concepts intuitively, curves grades fairly, and responds to email quickly.

reviews.subject: COMM 100 Public Speaking
reviews.review: SAMPLE: Supportive environment that builds confidence. Speeches are graded on clear criteria.

reviews.subject: PHYS 225 Physics for Scientists I
reviews.review: SAMPLE: Heavy math, few examples in lecture, and tough exams. Form a study group.

reviews.subject: KNES 151 Intro to Kinesiology
reviews.review: SAMPLE: Practical, hands-on labs. Easy to follow and the exams are fair.

reviews.subject: CPSC 351 Operating Systems
reviews.review: SAMPLE: Challenging projects in C, but you really learn how OS internals work. Helpful TAs.

reviews.subject: SOC 101 Intro to Sociology
reviews.review: SAMPLE: Interesting discussions, but grading of reflection papers can feel inconsistent.

reviews.subject: CPSC 481 Artificial Intelligence
reviews.review: SAMPLE: Modern, practical curriculum with projects on search and ML. Very accessible outside class.

reviews.subject: ART 100 Art Appreciation
reviews.review: SAMPLE: Relaxed, visual lectures and museum trips. Low-stress but attendance counts.
